title: Beamforming Design Via GNN in mmWave Cell-Free Massive MIMO Using Sub-6 GHz CSI
abstract: arXiv:2608.30524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beamforming methods in millimeter-wave (mmWave) cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CFmMIMO) systems require accurate channel state information (CSI), whose acquisition entails significant training overhead. This paper shows that fully digital cell-free mmWave beamforming can be effectively learned from sub-6 GHz CSI using a graph neural network (GNN). Specifically, we represent a CFmMIMO system as a wireless graph, and the GNN is trained to approximate beamformers that maximize the downlink sum-rate based on the available sub-6 GHz CSI. A message-passing mechanism is proposed to capture inter-user interference and inter-base-station cooperation across different network topologies. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed sub-6 GHz-assisted GNN-based beamformer achieves competitive and often superior sum-rate performance compared to classical baselines that rely on full mmWave CSI.

translated_title: 基于Sub-6 GHz信道状态信息的图神经网络毫米波无蜂窝大规模MIMO波束赋形设计
translated_abstract: 毫米波无蜂窝大规模多输入多输出（CFmMIMO）系统中的波束赋形方法需要精确的信道状态信息（CSI），而获取这些信息需要大量的训练开销。本文表明，全数字无蜂窝毫米波波束赋形可以通过图神经网络（GNN）从Sub-6 GHz信道状态信息中有效学习得到。具体而言，我们将无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统表示为无线图，并训练GNN基于可用的Sub-6 GHz信道状态信息来近似能够最大化下行链路和速率的波束赋形器。我们提出了一种消息传递机制，用于捕获不同网络拓扑下的用户间干扰和基站间协作。仿真结果表明，所提出的基于Sub-6 GHz辅助的GNN波束赋形器相比依赖完整毫米波信道状态信息的经典基线方法，实现了具有竞争力且通常更优的和速率性能。
tldr: 本文提出利用图神经网络从低频段Sub-6 GHz信道状态信息中学习毫米波无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统的全数字波束赋形，无需获取高开销的毫米波CSI即可实现与经典方法相当甚至更优的和速率性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using a graph neural network to learn fully digital beamforming for mmWave cell-free massive MIMO systems from sub-6 GHz CSI, achieving competitive or superior sum-rate performance without the costly training overhead of acquiring mmWave CSI.
